text: dsh-talk-map 是面向 DSH Web 的可视化会话地图插件，把会话呈现在可拖动、可分组的画布卡片上，并将画布位置、连线和摘要保存在 DSH storage domain。用户可以搜索会话、查看状态与最近消息、创建或打开会话，也能从已有会话连线分叉并注入摘要上下文；摘要通过部署默认模型生成。适合需要整理大量对话、追踪会话关系并快速恢复工作的人。

dsh-talk-map is a visual session board for DSH Web. Arrange conversations as draggable cards, organize them into workspaces, and search past sessions. Link a card to fork a new session with editable digest context. The map stores its layout in DSH storage; summaries use the configured default model.
想把 DSH 的许多对话按工作区摆在一张地图上。
有没有办法快速搜索以前聊过的会话并跳回去？
我想把一个会话的摘要带进新会话，方便接着做。
让 DSH 会话能像卡片一样拖动、分组和标记状态。
I want a visual board to organize and revisit my DSH conversations.
How can I branch a new session while carrying a digest of the current conversation?
dsh-talk-map 的功能「会话地图」：将 DSH 会话放在可拖动的画布卡片上，并保留地图位置和工作区组织。用户可打开地图管理会话。
dsh-talk-map 的功能「会话搜索与摘要」：可搜索历史会话并查看卡片摘要；会话轮次结束后，插件使用默认模型生成摘要、关键发现和下一步。
dsh-talk-map 的功能「上下文分叉」：从一张会话卡片拖出连线，可预览并编辑注入的摘要，再创建承接上下文的新会话。
我想把关联会话连起来，保留它们之间的上下文关系。
Can I keep my session positions and links organized on a persistent board?

dsh-talk-map README · dsh-talk-map · Talk Map：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A visual conversation map plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): every session becomes a card on an infinite whiteboard.

> Derived from [Tasihi89/dsh-talk-map](https://github.com/Tasihi89/dsh-talk-map) (MIT). This repository is a heavily reworked fork: slot layout, resizable workspaces, the overflow drawer and the routed links are additions or rewrites here.

dsh-talk-map README · dsh-talk-map · Talk Map：- **Spatial memory instead of working memory**: free placement + grid snapping, and nothing ever rearranges your cards — if you remember "that conversation was bottom-left", it stays bottom-left. Designed for ADHD users, useful for everyone.
- **Folders stay readable**: a workspace becomes a frame that auto-expands or folds its overflow into a stack cell you can open as a drawer; pinned cards stay in front.
- **Double-click to chat**: double-click empty canvas to start a new session; the card is born exactly where you clicked.
- **Draw an edge to fork**: drag a line from a card onto empty space, preview (and edit) the context digest to inject, confirm — a new session starts *knowing* the old conversation.
- **Card front = resume surface**: title, the last thing you said, relative time and a status lamp (running / finished / unread / waiting / interrupted). One glance tells you what to do next.
- **Lines mean something**: a link whose context is still up to date disappears; one that has fallen behind stays visible as a dashed line with an arrow. Fork lineage is always drawn.
- **Automatic digests**: a three-field digest (summary / key fi

dsh-talk-map README · dsh-talk-map · Talk Map：- **Status rail**: a collapsible strip on the left edge lists only the cards that carry a lamp (running / waiting / unread / interrupted). A card whose status changes jumps to the top, the order is yours to drag, a card that settles drops out, and the rail remembers whether you left it open.

dsh-talk-map README · Usage：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| Sidebar map button / Esc | toggle the map |
| Drag a card | place it (16px grid snap, persisted) |
| Double-click empty space | create a session there and enter it |
| Double-click a card | open that session |
| Drag from a card handle to empty space | preview injection → fork a new session |
| Click a stack cell | open the drawer listing the folded conversations |
| ⟳ on a card | regenerate the digest |
| Right-click a card / a line / a folder | pin, rename, mark unread, archive, delete, push switch, delete line |
| Language pill in the map header | cycle Auto → 中文 → English |

dsh-talk-map README · Where data lives：- Canvas data (positions, edges, digests): `$DSH_HOME/storages/talk_map.json` via dsh's official storage-domain, atomically persisted.
- Sessions themselves stay fully owned by dsh — this plugin reads them, and creates new ones only through official APIs when forking.
- Digests use your configured default model through dsh's local LLM channel; there are no other external requests.

dsh-talk-map README · Compatibility：Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3`. The structural contracts live in `src/client/dsh.ts` and `src/host/dsh-host.ts` — start there when upgrading.
